Overview

Legnica is a city in Lower Silesian with a population of 99,350. A historic city in Lower Silesia with a beautifully restored market square, a copper mining heritage, and a strategic location near the German border. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
